assumptions_and_scope: Associative unital noncommutative centrally essential rings of cardinality 64; one count per isomorphism class; classification from arXiv:2611.16086v1 assumed.
description: Eight-level ordered zero-product pair census of the 88 isomorphism classes of minimal noncommutative centrally essential rings, with sharp extremes and a unique cross-regime collision.
integrity: Exact symbolic radical-rank argument; direct canonical-table exhaustive checker for 88 representatives included.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify the rings anew or address cardinalities above 64. Historical priority beyond inspected primary literature and published records is provisional; no independent mathematical audit.
title: The eight-level annihilation spectrum at the minimum order for noncommutative centrally essential rings
